string-array.name: import_authy_steps
string-array.item: Authy has no export of its own, and its desktop app, which used to be the way around that, has been retired.

The sure way across is to set each account up again: open the site\'s two-factor settings, turn the authenticator off and on, and scan the new QR code with CometOTP. Only remove the account from Authy once a code from CometOTP has signed you in.
If you have a file of otpauth:// links made from Authy with another tool, choose it here instead.

resources.string: Authy\'s own 7-digit, 10-second codes for its partner services come across when the file carries their digits and period.
